response.justification: Bogdan is an experienced and versatile senior engineer, but his background is overwhelmingly web/full-stack (TypeScript, Node.js, DLang) rather than embedded networking firmware. The role has hard requirements he does not meet: native-level Japanese proficiency (not listed among his languages), Linux kernel investigation and source modification, and strong C for UNIX development (only a brief C/C++ stint at National Instruments over a decade ago). There is no evidence of security technologies such as MACsec, 802.1X, encryption/key exchange, L2/L3 switching, chip-vendor SDKs, or switch firmware experience. Despite strong general engineering credentials, the domain and language mismatch is disqualifying for this position.
strengths: 15+ years of professional software development across many domains
Strong engineering discipline: TDD, CI/CD, testing tooling, open-source contributions
Some low-level exposure (C/C++ at National Instruments, C++/Linux/Jack audio thesis, robotics work)
concerns: No Japanese language ability listed; native-level proficiency is a hard requirement
No embedded networking, LAN-switch, or security-protocol (MACsec, 802.1X, NETCONF/SNMP) experience
C for UNIX and Linux kernel modification skills are absent or over a decade stale

key_factors.factor: Weak/dated C and Linux kernel experience
